components.name: Transform
components.summary: Position, rotation and scale of an entity in the world

fields.name: scale
fields.desc: scale (1); a kinematic body with scale.x <= 0 is hidden and not moved by Physics

components.notes: matrix() = translate x rotate x scale. Dynamic bodies' Transforms are written by Physics (interpolated) or PhysicsStep; kinematic bodies follow theirs.

components.name: RigidBody
components.summary: A Jolt body next to a Transform: static, dynamic (simulated) or kinematic (follows its Transform)

fields.name: motion
fields.desc: Static, Dynamic (default), Kinematic; JSON static / dynamic / kinematic

fields.name: shape
fields.desc: Box (default), Sphere, Capsule; JSON box / sphere / capsule

fields.name: half_extent
fields.desc: box half sizes (0.5); sphere radius x; capsule radius x and cylinder half height y (local Y)

fields.name: offset
fields.desc: shape centre relative to the Transform position, local space (0)

fields.name: mass
fields.desc: kg, inertia scaled to it; 0: Jolt's density of 1000 kg/m3

fields.name: lock_rotation
fields.desc: dynamic only: translations only (a player's body)

fields.name: body
fields.desc: JPH::BodyID (index and sequence), 0xffffffff until RigidBodySys creates it; created()

components.notes: RigidBodySys makes the body on its next tick and removes it when the component or entity goes (on_destroy). Removed by RigidBodySys when the body cannot be made. Body user data = entity + 1 (bodyEntity).

components.name: Ground
components.summary: Flat ground: a static box whose top face is at top_y, centred on x = z = 0, STATIC layer
components.notes: Created by RigidBodySys in init and on later ticks; removed with the component.

components.name: HeightField
components.summary: Rolling hills: a static Jolt height field centred on the origin, heights from a sum of plane waves

fields.name: wavelength
fields.desc: log-uniform range of the wavelengths, metres (6, 40)

fields.name: wave_slope
fields.desc: steepest slope of each wave, amplitude x wavenumber (0.07)

fields.name: seed
fields.desc: wave draw seed; 0: one draw of the WorldRng

fields.name: wave_list
fields.desc: drawn at creation (k: wave vector on XZ rad/m, amplitude, phase)

components.notes: height(x, z) is the smooth surface (src/physics/height_field.cpp); the collider is its triangulation. size() = (samples - 1) x spacing.
